# HellaSwag permutation test

# PIQA pair-level data too

print(f'Max J_helped = {max_j:.6f} ({max_bench}, {max_pair})')

# Alpha spectrum (range of mean J_helped across benchmarks)

print(f'Range: {min(m[1] for m in means):.4f} - {max(m[1] for m in means):.4f}')
